item.description:
A selection of my projects. See the full list of repositories on GitHub.

Pet Projects

setbudget.app

Personal budget planning app for managing your budget plans, available as a mobile app.

invoices.ditrich.dev

Invoice creation tool with support for submitting to KSeF, the Polish e-invoicing system.

hybrit-battery-diagnostic-tool

A visualisation tool for hybrid battery diagnostics. TypeScript

AutomaticWateringSystem

ESP32-C3 firmware that reads soil moisture and automatically runs a USB water pump when the soil is dry. Built with ESP-IDF on a Super Mini board. C
